info.title: CommerceBook API
info.summary: Work your leads, CRM, capacity, messages and costs, or run your seller catalog and orders, with your own agent.
info.description: Keyed access for a member, with one of two kinds of key: an agent link key (the agent link https://commercebook.ai/agent/<token>, 90 days) reaches what its member’s kind reaches, plus GET /instructions, and a named key (made at Agent access) reaches the warehouse operations for a warehouse, or /seller/* and GET /me for a seller. Every key starts read-only: an agent link key carries the activities its owner turned on at Agent access, a named key carries the permissions chosen when it was made, and a call outside them answers 403 not_permitted with the activity and a hint. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer; every call runs as your member through the same rules as the app, is recorded on your ledger with the key id, and counts toward 600 calls per key per hour, and in the API a product listing is a lot (lot_id, lot_code, the /lots paths).

post.summary: Post a lead from a CRM deal or from fields
post.description: Writes the draft and lists it in the same call (draft: true keeps it a draft). The identity check runs on the server and refuses a need text that names the shipper (409 summary_names_shipper). outcome is posted, draft, blocked or duplicate. Leads must be true; confirmed false leads earn strikes that suspend posting (see /policies). While posting is suspended the call answers 403 posting_suspended with the end date as detail. With no price (no price_flat_cents, price_pct or terms) the lead takes your Lead defaults (GET /settings/lead-defaults): the price, and the buyer places unless exclusivity or max_buyers is sent. A deal whose CRM tags carry dnc, do-not-contact, do-not-solicit or do-not-call is refused (409 do_not_solicit). product, current_provider, inbound_mode, units_per_order and rate_expectation are kept in the lead attributes and count toward quality, the lead quality score in the answer (0 to 9).

post.summary: Claim a lead
post.description: A free lead, or a deployment without card payments, claims on the demo path (payment demo). A priced lead with payments configured is paid without a client secret: method balance pays from the member’s balance at once (no processing line), method card charges the owner’s saved card off-session (price plus 2.90 percent plus 30 cents). Without method: the balance when it covers the price, else the saved card. The answer is status paid with claim_id, amount_cents (the buyer total), processing_cents and method; the contact is revealed at once. 409 no_payment_method (hint: the owner saves a card at Settings, Payment methods, or funds the balance at Settings, Balance); 409 balance_insufficient with shortfall_cents; 409 payment_needs_owner when the card needs the bank’s check (a pending row with reason card_authentication waits at Agent access); 403 not_permitted with activity payments until the owner turns payments on. The spending cap and the confirm amount apply to the buyer total.
